title: reusable-ci artifacts.yml
description: Declarative release plan for a repository. See docs/artifacts-reference.md.

sign.description: Signing backend for `release sign` and `release sbom-zip --sign`. See docs/verification.md#signing-methods-for-release-artefacts.

method.description: gpg (default; uses $GPG_PRIVATE_KEY), sigstore (keyless cosign + OIDC), or kms (cosign + key).

key.description: cosign --key reference for method=kms. Allowed schemes: awskms://, gcpkms://, azurekms://, hashivault://, pkcs11:, file: (intentionally explicit prefix for local key files). Other schemes are rejected as a security-hardening measure.

oidc-issuer.description: OIDC issuer URL for method=sigstore (default: auto-detected — GitHub Actions / GitLab / $CI_SERVER_URL). Must be HTTPS.

projectType.description: Ecosystem identifier. `go` and `cargo` require config.build-mode (artifact-first|container-first). Python is recognized as a future placeholder but is not currently a valid choice — no build/publish workflow exists; setting it would silently produce nothing.

sboms.description: Enum or comma-list. Valid: all, none, build, analyzed-artifact, analyzed-container, or a comma-separated subset.

require-authorization.description: When true, the release tag must be signed by a key listed in .reusable-ci/allowed_signers (SSH) or .reusable-ci/allowed_gpg_fingerprints (GPG).

config.description: Per-ecosystem options. Schema varies by project-type — see docs/artifacts-reference.md for the field list of each ecosystem.

from.description: Artifact names this container consumes (matching artifacts[].name).

enable-slsa.description: Generate SLSA build provenance for this container. Default: true. Set false to disable on a debug/testing container that shouldn't carry provenance.

enable-scan.description: Run Trivy vulnerability scan AND gate the publish on its findings. Default: true. Set false to skip both the scan and the CVE gate (not recommended for production).

scan-severity.description: Per-container override of the trivy --severity filter and fail-on threshold. Default 'CRITICAL,HIGH'. Narrow (e.g. 'CRITICAL') to relax the gate without disabling the scan; use enable-scan: false to skip the gate entirely.

build-secrets.description: Names of BuildKit secrets to forward into the Containerfile build as `--mount=type=secret,id=<lowercased-name>` mounts. Values come from the REUSABLE_CI_BUILD_SECRETS_JSON envelope packed by the caller workflow; the publish-container materialize step writes them to mode-0600 tmpfiles for the duration of the build. Unlike build-args, these values are NEVER recorded in SLSA provenance attestations — use this for any secret consumed at build time (private package tokens, build-time API keys). See docs/artifacts-reference.md for the full caller recipe.

target.description: Containerfile stage that exposes the binary (typically a `FROM scratch` export-binary stage).

names.description: Expected binary filenames; the build fails if any are missing.
